tools.name: check_logo_name
tools.description: Checks how a business name will read on a logo and suggests a shorter logo version when the name has a legal ending (Inc, LLC), a web address, a generic company word (Group, Solutions) or a word for what the business sells. The rules come from a study of about 1,000 well-designed brand logos.
